name: Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu Ni Kasuga to Nisshin
original_name: 旭日ニ戀露ス弐　春日ト日進
source:
"This bond is deeper than love."

This game is based on "Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu".
Set in the navy of the Meiji era during the Russo-Japanese War,
we follow the lives of 3 commissioned officers in springtime and thereafter.

translation:
“这份羁绊比爱情更深。”

本作基于《在旭日中袒露真心》。故事发生在明治时代日俄战争期间，讲述三名军官在春日及之后的生活。
